concerns.text: T018 writes delta_scores.csv with columns (participant_id, delta_complexity_lzc, delta_complexity_pe, delta_fatigue) — a single delta per participant — but complexity is computed per channel (T016), and the correlations in the same task are 'per channel'. The implementer cannot tell whether deltas are per-channel (needing channel in the CSV) or averaged across channels. Specify the grain of delta_scores.csv (add `channel` or state channel-averaging) so the pairing and downstream per-channel correlation are executable.

T018 requires '95% CIs for the effect sizes, conforming to analysis_result.schema.yaml fields', but the named columns for raw_correlation_results.csv are (channel, metric_type, pearson_r, pearson_p, spearman_r, spearman_p) with no CI columns, and the schema uses different field names (correlation_coef, p_value_raw, effect_size_ci_lower/upper, result_id). Column list and schema disagree; name the exact CI columns to write so the CSV is deterministic.

T020 must write correlation_results.csv conforming to analysis_output.schema.yaml, which REQUIRES `vif` and `confounds_controlled` per row — but VIF is computed by T024, which the stated execution order runs in PARALLEL with T020 ('T018 → (T020, T024 parallel)'). T020 cannot fill a required field whose producer has not run. Either sequence T024 before T020 or specify how T020 populates `vif`/`confounds_controlled`.

T016 names `nolds.lz_complexity` for LZC but does not name the library/function for PE (plan lists `pyentropy`; `nolds` also offers permutation entropy). Pin the PE implementation and its normalization so the 'PE ≤ log2(3!) ≈ 2.585' verification is well-defined (normalized vs raw PE differ).

T023 produces two files (sensitivity_table_raw.csv, sensitivity_table_corrected.csv) while the plan and contract map a single sensitivity_table.csv; the schema's column set is not shown to match (threshold, significant_electrodes_count). Reconcile filenames/columns with the contract so the contract test is executable.
